payload.text: ISSUE:0696 (hv decision 58): banked at refs/bank/cc/0696/ungated-on-0640cd65a, blob c4484b78af07, patch-id fb90f00a2a62, one path (the arm's own file). The mechanism, found by reading: std::fs::write creates the sentinel empty and then fills it, so under load the watcher can reconcile it half-written, and one sentinel then costs two counted ingests. The fix: each sentinel is staged under intent/.cache/ and renamed in whole, and each measurement ends when the daemon's store holds its sentinel (Op::ThreadList), not after 25 quiet polls. No intentd change and no new test. Proof: todo 53's one run.
